messages:
Anya (product-marketing): Need a concise one-pager for the Mar 28 webinar: security summary + SLA tiers + deploy-mode decision guide + a short benchmark nugget. Field-ready for SDRs and speakers by EOD Fri.
Mike G (growth): Also want 2 LinkedIn variants for AB tests and CRM routing rules by deploy interest.
Sophia (solutions): Top security asks mapped to modes: data residency -> Private; KMS/BYOK -> Dedicated/Private; audit logs/SIEM -> all modes. I'll draft a 3-bullet checklist.
Rohit (eng): Benchmark blurb (conservative): Dedicated H100 pools w/ KV caching and mixed precision show ~1.6-1.8x throughput vs A100 on 2k-seq workloads; ~35-45% lower per-token cost in steady-state pilots. Note: seq=2048, batch=8-16, warm cache.
Olivia (design): Layout plan: left = problem + security checklist, middle = deploy-mode decision flow (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), right = benchmark callouts + routing snippet. Two colorways for sales. Need copy Thu noon.
Anya (product-marketing): Hero 20-word elevator: "Redwood Inference: unified, predictable and cost-efficient LLM serving with enterprise SLAs and flexible deployment modes for regulated workloads."
Mike G (growth): Quick routing pseudo for Intercom/CRM: if lead.tags include "private" or company.size > 500 -> assign SDR-enterprise; if text contains "SLA" -> tag sla-escalation -> AE; else -> product-nurture.
Sophia (solutions): SLA tiers (aspirational): Standard 99.5% / p50 ~100ms; Premium 99.95% / p50 ~50ms; Enterprise 99.99% / p50 ~30ms. Note: requires committed capacity.
Mike G (growth): LinkedIn Variant A (product-led): "Predictable, cost-efficient LLM serving: Redwood Inference reduces per-token costs with caching, batching, and smart routing. Join our Mar 28 webinar to see results and deployment guidance. #LLM #inference"
Mike G (growth): LinkedIn Variant B (security-first): "Building regulated AI? Redwood Inference offers enterprise SLAs, private deployment options, and KMS integrations so you can ship securely. See benchmarked TCO wins on Mar 28. #security #AI"
Anya (product-marketing): Sophia to finalize security bullets Thu AM, Rohit finalizes perf blurb, Olivia ships PDF export Thu PM, Mike finalizes posts and routing. I'll assemble and drop to #sales-review by EOD Fri.
marketing-bot: Webinar "Secure Serving: Deploy Modes & SLAs" Mar 28 — RSVP reminder.
